name: sol-advisor
description: Haru fork of Sol Advisor with explicit Sol/Luna/Terra model-specific routing and routine-coding delegation to Luna.

interface.shortDescription: Sol plans; Luna handles routine coding; Terra handles harder implementation; fresh Sol reviews.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor keeps GPT-6.1 Sol / High in the primary Codex session for architecture, requirements, verification, and acceptance. Fully specified bounded routine implementation is preferentially delegated to GPT-6 Luna / Max. Judgment-heavy, architecture-sensitive, context-heavy, high-risk, or wide-blast-radius implementation goes to GPT-5.6 Terra / High. Audit and full routes use a fresh read-only GPT-6.1 Sol / High reviewer. Auxiliary work substitutes for primary implementation rather than duplicating it.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-advisor:orchestration to declare a SELECTIVE ROUTE before task tools, then build and verify this feature.
Keep architecture and acceptance in Sol; prefer Luna for fully specified routine coding, Terra for harder implementation, and fresh Sol only when review is selected.
